title: dreams taking place where you’re sleeping but crazy things happening also….
content: This is Quite deep but a boy that used to live in the same house as me abused me for 6 years from ages 9-15 (i’m 21) but i keep having dreams of him doing horrible things to me in the exact place i am (my bed) my room is set up the way it is everything’s the same but he’s there trying to attack me (in my dream) i’ve not seen him since 2019 (he’s in jail) but i’m imagining other people I live with doing the same things to me in my sleep and it’s freaking me out because i’m imagining minors abusing me…. i’m pretty sure it’s just the environment bringing it back up (i moved out for 5 months then moved back in but due to move out again in a few weeks) idk just wondering if anyone else has experienced similar or has any words of advice ! ☺️
